judge.description: Engine lookdev capture of the particles milestone. Score two things: that the capture shows what this description lists, and that the PARTICLES read as what they are (falling snow flakes, tumbling paper confetti, glowing twinkling sparkles) with the light and mood of the reference. The reference is a finished illustration and is NOT the target for the scene: the sparse procedural staging (a few simple blocks, a plain tiled floor, simple props), the absence of characters, buildings, depth of field, fog and other post effects are expected at this milestone and must not lower the score. Shows: a night scene on a dark violet background: a glowing pink neon tube shaped like a script letter S stands on a dark glossy violet deck edged by thin cyan and gold neon strips, with a soft bloom halo, and many gold and white four-point star sparkles twinkle and glow around it and above it
